resources.string: "Provisions persistent APN profiles (Internet, IMS, MMS, XCAP) from CARRIER_DB (prevents 3G invalid P-CSCF lockouts), enables Persistent VoLTE / VoWiFi (siminfo opt-in), and overrides CarrierConfig for VoLTE / VoWiFi / VoNR / 5G SA on Pixel 6–11."

"1. Turn on Wi-Fi (wireless debugging needs Wi-Fi)
2. Tap the button below; it opens Wireless debugging and posts a notification
3. In Wireless debugging tap "Pair device with pairing code" and keep the dialog open
4. Pull down the notification shade, type the 6-digit code into the notification and send"
"Pairing notification posted — enter the code from the system dialog"
"(The box below only helps if you can keep the pairing dialog in the foreground;\nnormally use the notification above.)"
"Paired but still cannot connect, try Re-check"
"Phone permission is required to read SIM state"

"1. Turn on Wi-Fi and connect to a network.
 ⚠️ Wireless debugging only works while Wi-Fi is connected — required.
2. Enable Developer options:
 Settings → About phone → tap "Build number" 7 times
 until you see "You are now a developer".
3. Enable Wireless debugging:
 Settings → System → Developer options → Wireless debugging,
 turn it on and keep it on.
4. Back here, tap "Start pairing" in the ADB channel card below,
 then type the 6-digit code from the system into the notification.
 Once it shows "Ready" you are paired — no need to pair again."

"1. Make sure the ADB channel below shows "Ready"
 (if unavailable, Wi-Fi or wireless debugging is usually off).
2. In each SIM card, choose the desired options (VoLTE, VoWiFi, VoNR, 5G SA, APN) —
 defaults are pre-filled from CARRIER_DB or the system profile.
3. Tap "Apply settings" to write them for that SIM,
 or "Reset" to restore the system profile.
4. CarrierConfig overrides are lost after a reboot — tap "Apply settings" again here,
 or tick "Re-apply after boot" in Options to replay them automatically."
"APN profiles (Internet, IMS, MMS, XCAP) from CARRIER_DB (%1$d carriers)"
"After changing options, flip the SIM switch again to write them."
"Cannot open Developer options; go to Settings → System → Developer options → Wireless debugging manually"
"Find the 6-digit code in the system pairing dialog and enter it below"
"Paired — go back to the app to configure settings"
"Pairing port not found: open Developer options → Wireless debugging → Pair device with pairing code first, then pair again"
"Cannot reach local ADB: make sure Developer options → Wireless debugging is on (Wi-Fi required) and pairing is done"
"Local ADB unavailable — enable Wi-Fi and Wireless debugging, then open the app"
